sections.title: Using this instance
sections.body: By creating an account, you can create and manage RPG campaigns. You are responsible for the content you publish and for respecting others’ rights.

sections.title: Account and access
sections.body: Provide an email address you control, protect your password, and do not share your session. The operator of this instance may disable accounts in case of abuse.

sections.title: Data and contact
sections.body: Account use involves the processing described in the privacy policy. For questions about these terms or data removal, contact the operator of this instance through the contact channels provided on the instance.

sections.title: Account and session
sections.body: The operator of this instance stores your email, password hash, and the time you accepted the terms. A session cookie keeps you signed in.

sections.title: Security and limits
sections.body: The system uses IP addresses and email addresses in temporary login lockout counters. It limits registration requests by IP and stores a hash of the canonical email for the per-email limit.

sections.title: Campaigns
sections.body: Content of campaigns you create is stored to provide the service. When you use AI features, the campaign context needed for the request is sent to DeepSeek; it may include hidden campaign content.

sections.title: External services
sections.body: Your email address is sent to Resend for account messages. When enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile verifies registration requests. This instance does not use analytics or its own third-party cookies.

sections.title: Contact and removal
sections.body: To request access, correction, or removal of your data, contact the operator of this instance through the contact channels provided on the instance. Removal may prevent account use.
